newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bank of Melb jumps on Advance merger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bank of Melb jumps on Advance merger.

text.p: Shares in Bank of Melbourne Ltd jumped 35 cents or 4.17 percent to A$8.75 in early Monday trade on speculation and then confirmation of St George Bank Ltd's bid to merge with Advance Bank Ltd.
Brokers said Bank of Melbourne could be the next remaining significant regional bank able to be taken over by the major banks if the merger is successful.
"It's on the basis that if St George and Advance merge, then Bank of Melbourne is the next candidate," said Neil Franklin at HSBC James Capel.

Earlier on Monday, St George and Advance announced they had agreed to a A$2.65 billion merger. St George said it would offer A$7.30 for each Advance Bank share and planned to raise up to A$360 million to fund the merger.
By 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT), Bank of Melbourne shares had risen further to A$8.80, up 40 cents on Friday's close, on turnover of 54,680 shares.
